age.evidence: Adult male and female Sprague-Dawley rats (8-10 weeks of age)

sex.evidence: Adult male and female Sprague-Dawley rats (8-10 weeks of age) from an established breeding colony at Ohio Northern University

dosing.evidence: Rats were given intraperitoneal injections of PSIL (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), NOR (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), or vehicle (0.9% saline) at a volume of 1 ml/kg. (Exp 3: 0.6 mg/kg given on Day 11 and again on Day 14.)

Rats were given intraperitoneal injections of PSIL (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), NOR (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), or vehicle (0.9% saline) at a volume of 1 ml/kg. (Exp 3: 0.6 mg/kg given on Day 11 and again on Day 14.)

handling.evidence: handled for 2-3 min daily for a period of 1 week prior to any experimental manipulations

group_housing.evidence: housed in standard Plexiglas cages with 2-3 rats per cage

day_night_flipped.evidence: Animals were housed on a 12-h light/dark schedule (lights on at 0700)... All experimental manipulations... took place during the light cycle

enrichment_housing.evidence: each cage included ¼" corncob bedding and free access to food and water; no enrichment items mentioned

assays.assay_description: 5-min test on EPM (two open and two closed arms, 115 cm each, 51.5 cm above ground, ~4 lux), videotaped and scored with LimeLight; open arm time, open arm entries, distance traveled. Tested 30 min after PSIL/NOR/vehicle (0.3-1 mg/kg) in Exp 1, 24 h after 1 mg/kg in Exp 2, and 30 min after 0.6 mg/kg in estrous-tracked females in Exp 3; males and females.

application_type.evidence: Rats were given intraperitoneal injections of PSIL (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), NOR (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), or vehicle (0.9% saline)

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the EPM apparatus described

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed in the intersection of the open and closed arms, facing an open arm

food_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM apparatus; no food in the apparatus during the 5-min test

water_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM apparatus; no water in the apparatus during the 5-min test

time_to_assay.evidence: 30 min prior to being tested on the EPM (Exp 1); 'The next day, the rats were tested on the EPM' (Exp 2, ~24 h); 'Thirty minutes later, the rats were placed on the EPM for 5 min' (Exp 3)

sample_size.evidence: Group n not explicitly reported; only ANOVA df given (e.g., males Exp1 F(6,58); females Exp1 F(6,64); Exp3 F(2,118)). Discussion notes 'over 40 females administered PSIL' in Exp 3.

outcomes.summary: Acutely, 0.6 and 1 mg/kg PSIL and 1 mg/kg NOR reduced open-arm time in males, whereas only 1 mg/kg PSIL did so in females; 1 mg/kg PSIL also reduced distance traveled in both sexes. No effects 24 h after 1 mg/kg (Exp 2). In Exp 3, 0.6 mg/kg PSIL (but not NOR) reduced open-arm time and distance in females independent of estrous stage.
outcomes.evidence: Males treated with 0.6 mg/kg PSIL (p = 0.049), 1 mg/kg PSIL (p = 0.041), or 1 mg/kg NOR (p = 0.015) spent less time in the open arms of the EPM than vehicle-treated males... In Experiment 2, neither PSIL nor NOR impacted EPM behavior the next day.

B1_num_measures.evidence: We calculated the time rats spent in the open arms, the number of entries rats made into the open arms, and the overall distance rats traveled on the maze.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only whole-session totals reported; no within-session time course.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures are spatial/locomotor (open arm time, entries, distance).

B5_social.evidence: EPM anxiety test; animals tested individually.

B6_cognitive.evidence: EPM is an innate-avoidance anxiety test.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: scored using the LimeLight software program (Lafayette Instrument Co.) — position tracking.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Each measure from the EPM and OFT was analyzed with a one-way ANOVA

E1_environment_type.evidence: The EPM (San Diego Instruments, San Diego, CA) consisted of two open arms (115-cm length) and two closed arms

E2_shelter.evidence: definitionally absent — EPM closed arms are not a shelter per rubric

E3_bedding.evidence: definitionally absent — no bedding on EPM

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are extensions of a central platform; scored as single space per rubric

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed in the intersection of the open and closed arms — tested individually

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water on EPM during 5-min test

D1_continuity.evidence: EPM run in Exp 1 (30 min post-injection), Exp 2 (next day), and Exp 3 (Day 11).

D2_session_duration.evidence: assessing rat behavior on an elevated plus maze (EPM) for 5 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: EPM data collected across separate experiments/days (Exp 1, Exp 2, Exp 3 Day 11).

D5_followup.evidence: Male and female rats were injected with PSIL (1 mg/kg), NOR (1 mg/kg), or vehicle and then returned to their home cage. The next day, the rats were tested on the EPM

assays.assay_description: 10-min test in a 61×61×61 cm opaque Plexiglas open field with gridded floor (9 grids), ~4 lux, videotaped and scored with LimeLight; center time, distance traveled, grid crossings. Tested 30 min after PSIL/NOR/vehicle (0.3-1 mg/kg), males and females (Exp 1).

application_type.evidence: Rats were given intraperitoneal injections of PSIL (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), NOR (0.3, 0.6, or 1 mg/kg), or vehicle

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the open field described

setup_restrain.evidence: locomotor activity and anxiety-like behavior were examined by placing rats in an open field (OFT) for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: Standard open field; no food in apparatus during test

water_restriction.evidence: Standard open field; no water in apparatus during test

time_to_assay.evidence: injected with PSIL... NOR..., or vehicle 30 min prior to being tested on the EPM or in the OFT

sample_size.evidence: Group n not explicitly reported; ANOVA df only (males F(6,66), females F(6,60)). 'Separate groups of animals were tested in the EPM and OFT.'

outcomes.summary: Lower doses (especially 0.3 mg/kg NOR) increased center time and locomotion, whereas higher doses (notably 1 mg/kg PSIL) reduced center time, distance and grid crossings; 0.3 mg/kg NOR increased center time in males vs vehicle, and 1 mg/kg PSIL reduced center time in females vs low-dose NOR.
outcomes.statistics: Males: center time F(6,66)=5.75, p<0.001; distance F(6,66)=14.28, p<0.001; grid crossings F(6,68)=7.21, p<0.001. Females: center time F(6,60)=3.50, p=0.005; distance F(6,62)=21.32, p<0.001; grid crossings F(6,64)=8.90, p<0.001.
outcomes.evidence: In both sexes, there appeared to be a linear relationship between drug dose and each dependent measure; the higher the dose of each drug, the less time spent in the center area, the less distance traveled, and the fewer grids crossed.

B1_num_measures.evidence: We calculated the time rats spent in the center of the open field (centermost grid), total distance traveled, and the number of grids crossed.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: scored using the LimeLight software program (Lafayette Instrument Co.) — position tracking.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Each measure from the EPM and OFT was analyzed with a one-way ANOVA

E1_environment_type.evidence: The open field (61 × 61 × 61 cm) was made of four opaque Plexiglas sides and a gridded Plexiglas bottom

E6_spatial.evidence: Grids are scoring zones, not physical compartments

D2_session_duration.evidence: placing rats in an open field (OFT) for 10 min

assays.assay_description: Females (Exp 3) placed in a Plexiglas cylinder in a soundproof SR-LAB startle chamber; 5-min acclimation (68 dB) then 30 × 110-dB, 40-ms white-noise bursts at 30-45 s ISI; peak startle averaged in blocks of 5 trials. Tested 30 min after 0.6 mg/kg PSIL/NOR/vehicle on Day 14, with estrous stage as a factor.

application_type.evidence: On Day 14, the rats were injected with the same treatment they received on Day 11. Thirty minutes later, the rats were tested for their acoustic startle response (ASR).

setup_habituation.evidence: Each session began with a 5-min acclimation period (68-dB background noise) — within-session acclimation, not separate apparatus habituation

setup_restrain.evidence: Inside the chamber, rats were placed in a Plexiglas cylinder

food_restriction.evidence: Startle chamber; no food during session

water_restriction.evidence: Startle chamber; no water during session

time_to_assay.evidence: Thirty minutes later, the rats were tested for their acoustic startle response (ASR).

sample_size.evidence: Group n not explicitly reported; only ANOVA df given (e.g., F(5,565)).

outcomes.summary: Startle declined across trial blocks (habituation). PSIL lowered startle vs vehicle in the 5th block in diestrus (p=0.02), with a trend in estrus (p=0.07), suggesting enhanced habituation; NOR effects were not significant.
outcomes.statistics: Trial block F(5,565)=3.99, p=0.001; Drug x Trial Block F(10,565)=2.55, p=0.005; Estrus x Drug x Trial Block F(30,565)=1.49, p=0.047; diestrus PSIL vs vehicle p=0.02; estrus p=0.07.
outcomes.evidence: When rats were in estrus (p = 0.07) or diestrus (p = 0.02), PSIL led to lower startle responses than vehicle, particularly during the 5th block of trials, although the post hoc comparison for rats in estrus was only a trend

B1_num_measures.evidence: The peak startle responses from blocks of 5 trials were averaged and used for statistical analysis.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Female startle responses decreased as trials progressed [effect of trial block: F(5,565) = 3.99, p = 0.001]

B4_ethological.evidence: Startle magnitude is a reflex measure

B6_cognitive.evidence: Reflexive startle/habituation, not a learned task

B7_automated_classification.evidence: movement... was detected via a piezoelectric accelerometer

B8_multivariate.evidence: ASR data from Experiment 3 were analyzed with a mixed-model ANOVA

E1_environment_type.evidence: soundproof startle chamber (SR-LAB system, San Diego Instruments)

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5-min acclimation period... followed by 30 noise bursts... presented at 30-45 s inter-stimulus intervals (≥~19.5 min total by these stated parameters)

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same three assays (EPM, OFT, ASR); EPM across Experiments 1–3 collapsed into one assay per rubric (same paradigm, different timepoints/doses/cohorts). Vaginal lavage/estrous staging is not a behavioural assay and was excluded.
EPM and OFT B1 set to score 1 (3 measures = 2-3 category); gemma4's score of 2 was inconsistent with its own category.
ASR B1 set to 0 (single measure: peak startle); gemma4's score of 1 overridden.
OFT D2 set to 0 (10 min < 15 min); qwen's score of 1 was a boundary error.
ASR D2 scored 1 (modal): total not stated but stated parameters (5-min acclimation + 30 bursts at ≥30 s ISI) give ≥~19.5 min; confidence medium.
ASR setup_habituation set to not_reported: the 5-min acclimation is within-session, which the rubric explicitly excludes from setup habituation (overrides modal 'yes').
ASR time_dependent set to n/a (single timepoint); trial-block effects are within-session, captured in B2.
Sample sizes left null: group n's are not explicitly reported, only ANOVA degrees of freedom; qwen's df-derived estimates were not adopted.
Dosing schedule kept as 'acute' (modal) though Exp 3 animals received the same dose twice (Days 11 and 14); noted in evidence.
enrichment_housing set to not_reported (modal); corncob bedding alone is not enrichment and absence of enrichment was not explicitly stated.
